name: Notion AI
summary: Notion AI writes and summarizes inside Notion pages and databases. A business user can turn notes into a page or tidy a draft they already keep in Notion.
paragraphs: Notion AI writes and summarizes inside Notion pages and databases. A business user can turn notes into a page or tidy a draft they already keep in Notion.
whyItMatters: Use it on pages the team already keeps in Notion, and edit the text before you share it.
